That night, while they were having dinner, Marina told Pablo the whole story. He laughed and said, 'Next time, take the plane!'

contar-historia.instruction: Corregí el error en la oración.

wrongAnswers.answer: When Nico arrived at the party, he realized he forgot the gift at home.
wrongAnswers.why: El pasado simple no marca claramente que olvidar el regalo fue anterior a llegar a la fiesta; se necesita pasado perfecto.

contar-historia.instruction: Leé la historia y elegí la opción correcta para cada pregunta.
contar-historia.text: Last winter, Lucía was travelling to Bariloche to visit her cousin Martín. It was a freezing Friday evening and she was waiting at the bus terminal in Buenos Aires. She had already bought her ticket online, so she wasn't worried about missing the bus. First, she checked her phone and saw a message from Martín. Then, she looked for her passport in her bag, but she couldn't find it. Suddenly, she remembered that she had left it on the kitchen table that morning. She felt terrible because the bus was leaving in twenty minutes. As soon as she called her mother, she explained the problem. Her mother said she could bring the passport to the terminal, but the traffic was heavy. Lucía waited anxiously. Eventually, her mother arrived with only five minutes to spare. In the end, Lucía managed to get on the bus just in time, and she finally relaxed when it left the station.

questions.prompt: ¿Por qué Lucía no podía encontrar el pasaporte en su bolso?
options: Because she was waiting at the bus terminal.
Because her mother had lost it.
Because the bus was leaving in twenty minutes.
Because she had left it on the kitchen table that morning.
questions.explanation: El past perfect (had left) marca una acción anterior al momento del relato: ella ya había dejado el pasaporte en su casa antes de llegar a la terminal.

questions.prompt: Según la historia, ¿qué había pasado antes de que Lucía llegara a la terminal?
options: She had already bought her ticket online.
She was going to buy it at the terminal.
She lost her ticket at the terminal.
Martín had bought it for her.
questions.explanation: El texto usa el past perfect (had already bought) para indicar una acción completada antes de otro momento del pasado, en este caso antes de llegar a esperar el colectivo.

options: Because her mother drove her to Bariloche.
Because she got on the bus just in time.
Because she found her passport at the terminal.
questions.explanation: La expresión 'in the end' introduce el resultado final de toda la secuencia de hechos: después de los problemas, logró subirse al colectivo justo a tiempo.

contar-historia.instruction: Leé la historia y elegí la opción correcta para cada pregunta.
contar-historia.text: Daniel had an important job interview at a marketing agency in Palermo last Tuesday. It was a sunny morning and he was walking to the office, feeling confident. He had prepared his answers the night before, so he wasn't nervous. First, he arrived at the building and waited in the reception area. Then, the receptionist told him that the interviewer, Ms. Torres, was running late because of a meeting. While he was waiting, he was reading his notes again. After that, Ms. Torres finally called him into her office. As soon as the interview began, she asked him why he had left his previous job. Daniel explained that the company had closed down three months earlier. Suddenly, Ms. Torres smiled and said she had read his CV carefully and was impressed. They talked for almost an hour. Eventually, she told him the agency would contact him soon. In the end, Daniel left the building feeling relieved, even though he didn't know the final result yet.

questions.prompt: ¿Por qué Daniel no estaba nervioso antes de la entrevista?
options: Because the agency had already hired him.
Because he had prepared his answers the night before.
Because Ms. Torres was running late.
questions.explanation: El past perfect (had prepared) muestra una acción terminada antes del momento de la entrevista, que explica por qué él se sentía seguro esa mañana.

questions.prompt: ¿Por qué Daniel había dejado su trabajo anterior?
options: Because Ms. Torres offered him a better salary.
Because he didn't like his old job.
Because he wanted to work in Palermo.
Because the company had closed down three months earlier.
questions.explanation: El relato usa el past perfect (had closed down) para contar un hecho anterior que explica la pregunta de la entrevistadora, formulada en past simple (asked).

questions.prompt: ¿Qué estaba haciendo Daniel mientras esperaba a Ms. Torres?
options: He was reading his notes again.
He was talking to the receptionist.
He was calling his previous boss.
questions.explanation: El past continuous (was reading) describe una acción en curso durante ese momento de la espera, mientras ocurrían los otros hechos puntuales en past simple.
